Both could be fine—it depends on your needs, not just price.

Focus on fit, not cost alone: pick the firmness (1–10 scale) that suits your sleep position and body weight.
Check materials & build: thicker or multi-layer foams and more durable materials often cost more but can add comfort/support.
Use the in‑home trial: our extended, hassle‑free trial lets you test the mattress at home and return it at no cost if it doesn’t feel right.

If the cheaper option meets your firmness, support, and comfort needs during the trial, it’s perfectly fine; the pricier one is only “worth it” if those extra features noticeably improve your sleep.
